places.name: CS Block
places.landmark: Block labelled CS BLOCK on the campus map, north of the library
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Computer Science teaching block. The floor for a given lab is confirmed by the department timetable, which is not published as open data.

places.name: G Block
places.landmark: Block labelled G on the campus map, between CS Block and B Block
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Academic block G. Room-level allocation lives in the department timetable and is not exposed as a public dataset.

places.name: B Block
places.landmark: Block labelled B on the campus map, east of G Block
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Academic block B. Used for lectures and labs; per-room schedules are not published as open data.

places.name: C Block
places.landmark: Block labelled C on the campus map, east of B Block
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Academic block C, the easternmost of the four teaching blocks on the map.

places.name: Central Library
places.landmark: Building labelled LIBRARY at the centre of the campus map
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Central library and reading halls. Seat availability is not published by TIET, so this app does not show live free seats.

places.name: LP 101-103
places.landmark: Label LP 101-103 printed beside the Library on the campus map
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Lecture hall cluster attached to the library block. Which course sits in which room is timetable data, not public data.

places.name: LP 110-111
places.landmark: Label LP 110-111 printed beside the Library on the campus map
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Second lecture hall cluster beside the library. Room allocation per course is not published as open data.

places.name: Dean Office
places.landmark: Label DEAN OFFICE printed beside the Library on the campus map
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Dean's office as labelled on the campus map. Individual office hours are not published as open data.

places.name: Open Air Theatre (OAT)
places.landmark: Label OAT in the western part of the campus map
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Open air theatre used for cultural nights and institute events. The event calendar is not published as open data.

places.name: Prithvi Hall
places.landmark: Label PRITHVI HALL in the south-west of the campus map
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Residential hall labelled PRITHVI HALL on the campus map. Occupancy and curfew details live with the hostel office.

places.name: Vyom Hall
places.landmark: Label VYOM HALL east of Prithvi Hall on the campus map
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Residential hall labelled VYOM HALL on the campus map. Room allocation is handled by the hostel office.

places.name: Vahni Hall
places.landmark: Label VAHNI HALL south of the library on the campus map
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Residential hall labelled VAHNI HALL on the campus map. Visitor rules are set by the hostel office and are not published here.

places.name: Food Court
places.landmark: Building labelled FOOD COURT in the west of the campus map
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Food court on the western side of campus. Individual stall names, menus and prices are not published as an open dataset.

places.name: Canteen
places.landmark: Label CANTEEN south-west of the library on the campus map
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Main canteen labelled CANTEEN on the campus map. Live queue length is not measured or published.

places.name: Streat Cafe
places.landmark: Label STREAT CAFE east of the canteen on the campus map
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Cafe labelled STREAT CAFE on the campus map. Operating hours are not published as open data.

places.name: Aahar
places.landmark: Label AAHAR south-east of the library on the campus map
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Dining hall labelled AAHAR on the campus map. Live headcount and waste figures are simulated in the Ops view, not claimed as real.

places.name: Sports Complex
places.landmark: Large open ground in the north-west, not individually labelled on the map
places.source: Campus layout; no printed label on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg
places.description: Sports ground and courts in the north-west of campus. Court booking is handled offline by the sports office.

places.name: Stationery & ATM
places.landmark: Label STATIONERY & ATM south of the library on the campus map
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Stationery counter and ATM labelled STATIONERY & ATM on the campus map. Machine uptime is not published.

places.name: TAN Block
places.landmark: Label TAN at the centre of the campus map, west of the library
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Block labelled TAN on the campus map. Vending machine stock levels are not published.

places.name: Main Administrative Block
places.landmark: Label MAIN ADMN in the south-east of the campus map, by the Main Entrance
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Administrative block labelled MAIN ADMN on the campus map. Fee counters, exam cell hours and health centre timings are not published as open data.

places.name: Main Entrance
places.landmark: Label MAIN ENTRANCE in the south-east of the campus map
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Primary campus entrance on the south-east edge of the map. Visitor rules are set by security.

places.name: North Gate
places.landmark: Gate on the northern edge, not individually labelled on the map
places.source: Campus layout; no printed label on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg
places.description: Northern gate on the campus map. Access hours are not published as open data.

places.name: Staff Quarters
places.landmark: Label STAFF QUARTERS north of the library on the campus map
places.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)
places.description: Staff residential area labelled STAFF QUARTERS on the campus map.

places.name: Golf Cart Stop - Main Entrance
places.landmark: Demo cart stop beside the Main Entrance on the campus map
places.source: Simulated dispatch loop in src/simulator.py
places.description: Simulated cart stop. Cart positions in this app come from a deterministic simulator, not from a live vehicle feed.

places.name: Golf Cart Stop - Library
places.landmark: Demo cart stop beside the Library on the campus map
places.source: Simulated dispatch loop in src/simulator.py
places.description: Simulated cart stop at the library. No live GPS feed is connected, so the ETA is a simulated estimate.

places.name: Golf Cart Stop - North Gate
places.landmark: Demo cart stop at the North Gate on the campus map
places.source: Simulated dispatch loop in src/simulator.py
places.description: Simulated cart stop at the North Gate. Cart positions are generated by the simulator, not tracked live.

departments.name: L. M. Thapar School of Management
Thapar School of Liberal Arts & Sciences

services.name: Place & alias search
services.detail: 26 labels from the shared TIET campus map, with student aliases. Every hit names its source.
services.source: TIET campus map (labels printed on frontend/public/campus-map.jpg)

services.name: Campus wayfinding
services.detail: 20-node / 35-edge walking graph with verified map anchors. Distances are modelled, not surveyed.

services.name: Faculty directory
services.detail: TIET publishes departments, not individual cabins. We list departments and do not invent professor offices.

services.name: Hostel directory
services.detail: Hall names come from the campus map; room allocation and occupancy are held by the hostel office.

services.name: Crowd forecasting
services.detail: Trained on a synthetic replay stream. Metrics are real, the underlying telemetry is not live campus data.

services.name: Incident triage
services.detail: Cluster summaries and evidence snippets are produced from synthetic reports.

services.name: Mess demand planning
services.detail: Headcount and waste figures are forecasts over synthetic history, shown only in Ops.

services.name: Golf cart dispatch
services.detail: Cart positions and ETAs come from a deterministic simulator. No live GPS feed is connected.

services.name: Library seat availability
services.detail: TIET does not publish live seat counts, so this app shows none instead of a made-up number.

services.name: Course to room lookup
services.detail: Room allocations live in the department timetable, which is not exposed as open data.

services.name: Live shuttle tracking
services.detail: No vehicle GPS feed is available. Only the simulated dispatch demo is offered.
